Develop, build and ship projects

Usage: kit [options] <command>

Commands:
  init  Create a new project

Build Commands:
  Turn sources into artifacts
  build, b
            Build the project
  test
            Run the tests

Workspace Commands:
  sync  Fetch and fast-forward every repository
  repo  Manage the repositories

Options:
  -v, --verbose
            Print more output
  -h, --help
            Print help

Output:
  How results are shown
  --color <auto|always|never>
            When to colour the output
            [default: auto]

Run 'kit --help-all' to list all 8 commands, or
'kit <command> --help' for details.
